methodology.title: منهجية استخراج مواضيع الكتابة (Writing Topics)
methodology.description: يتم استخراج مواضيع الكتابة من نهاية كل درس في كتاب الطالب وكتاب النشاط.

topics.title: Choose one superhero and write a short paragraph about him.
topics.sample_essay: My favourite superhero is Spider-Man. He wears a red and blue uniform. He has a special superpower. He can climb walls and shoot webs. He is very strong and fast. I like him because he helps people. He is brave and kind. He always saves people from danger. I wish I could be like him one day.

topics.title: Imagine you have a medicine which makes you invisible. Write a paragraph about what you would do if you became invisible.
guiding_questions: What would you do if you became invisible?
Would you use this power for good or bad?
topics.sample_essay: If I became invisible, I would help people. I would stop thieves and save children from danger. I would visit my friends and see what they do. I would also travel to different places without anyone seeing me. I would not use my power for bad things. I would only use it to help others and make the world a better place.
